signalTypes.definition: CLI/command/tool gap, confusing flag, missing capability, output that forced manual interpretation, or a tool that returned a misleading shape. Maps 1-to-1 to friction-report/toolchain/<date>/<slug> on toolchain-validator.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: the command invoked, the observed output, and the expected output (or the missing capability the operator wanted)

signalTypes.definition: Run-loop, heartbeat, or coordination friction — a place where agent execution stalled, looped, or required an extra heartbeat to make progress. Maps 1-to-1 to friction-report/run-execution/<date>/<slug> on run-introspector.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: the run/heartbeat reference, the stall or loop pattern observed, and what would have unblocked the run

signalTypes.definition: Storage-map ambiguity, write-target confusion, decision-vs-knowledge-vs-handoff misrouting, or team/agent role boundaries that produced the wrong artifact. Maps 1-to-1 to friction-report/prompt-team-agent-storage/<date>/<slug> on team-agent-optimizer.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: the storage decision the reporter faced, what they wrote (or didn't), and what they think the correct destination would have been

signalTypes.definition: A workaround the reporter has applied multiple times across heartbeats or runs — a pattern that's costing recurring tokens or attention. Maps 1-to-1 to friction-report/recurring-workaround/<date>/<slug> on debt-curator for synthesis.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: the workaround applied, the count or recurrence frequency observed, and the underlying gap the workaround compensates for

signalTypes.definition: Scope unclear at report time; curator reclassifies during triage. The curator is required to reclassify into one of the four real scopes before routing — never write to friction-report/recurring-workaround/* directly from unknown (that would corrupt debt-curator's synthesis input).
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: any observation the reporter could capture; the curator owns classification

evidenceRules: Severity is the producer's claim; the curator may overrule based on actual scope of impact discovered during routing.
Honesty flags must include `speculative-cause` when the reporter guessed at why the friction happened.
`one-off` severity entries are dropped by the curator with a triage note; reporters should mention one-off friction in handoff instead of filing.
`recurring` severity requires evidence of recurrence: count of past occurrences, or a pointer to a prior friction entry the reporter is amplifying.
`blocking` severity requires that the reporter is currently stopped (not just slowed); blockers route via handoff or capability-work depending on whether a fix exists.

`unknown` scope requires the curator to reclassify before routing; if reclassification fails after one heartbeat, the curator hands off to debt-curator with full context — never direct-edits to friction-report/recurring-workaround/* from unknown.

Friction entries are observation, not authority. The destination scoped-topic owners (toolchain-validator, run-introspector, team-agent-optimizer, debt-curator) decide what action follows; the original friction-inbox entry is closed on routing.

actionSelection.route: Default action. Curator classifies scope (or accepts reporter's classification), then writes the entry to friction-report/<scope>/<date>/<slug> on the scoped-topic owner's behalf. Original friction-inbox entry is closed after the routing record lands in friction-triage.
actionSelection.drop: Severity = one-off + no clear recurrence pattern. Curator writes a short note in friction-triage explaining the drop and removes the friction-inbox entry. Reporter should use handoff next time.
actionSelection.handoff-debt-curator: Scope = unknown and reclassification failed after one heartbeat, OR friction-inbox is overflowing past dailyInboxDrainCap. Curator hands off to debt-curator for synthesis with full context. The friction-inbox entry stays open until debt-curator acks.
actionSelection.reclassify: Scope = unknown but evidence supports a clear reclassification. Curator rewrites the topic to friction-inbox/<real-scope>/<slug>, then proceeds to route on the next heartbeat. Mirrors bug-investigator's route-to-another-topic action.
actionSelection.overflow-flag: Inbox exceeded dailyInboxDrainCap. Curator emits a friction-triage entry tagged `inbox-overflow`, hands off to debt-curator, and pauses further routing this heartbeat.

frontMatter.context: <context object: scenario, skill, member, command, doc, task — any may be null>
